main_body: A flat grass ground patch (terrain) with a few small flowers and darker grass tufts, with no standing volume
top_band: none - terrain tile, flat ground surface seen from above, no standing object
evidence: The candidate is a flat grass ground patch with mid-green base, darker tufts and a few pink/yellow flowers. It is terrain, not a standing object, so no top band or front face is expected. No receding side faces are drawn and it is not a front elevation.

style.evidence: The grass has a mid-green base with lighter and darker tuft dots and a few darker clumps, plus three small flowers. The result is decent grass texture with about 4 green steps, but it is sparser than the Beodeul grass reference, which has denser tufts, a dark grass variant and more varied clumps. Large areas of the base are fairly uniform between the sparse dots, so tile density is somewhat lower than the reference. There are no outlines, which is fine for ground. It is acceptable next to the reference but slightly thinner.
